items.title: Pay overdue 2027 membership fee plus dunning fee
items.quote: Wir bitten Sie, den Rückstand bis einschließlich 4. Juni 2027 auf das unten genannte Vereinskonto zu überweisen.
items.computation: The club states an explicit calendar due date, inclusive: 'bis einschließlich 4. Juni 2027'. This is a private-law deadline set directly by the creditor, not a statutory period counted from a delivery date, so no §§187/188 BGB counting is needed. Checking the weekday: 2026-01-01 is a Thursday; 2026 has 365 days (365 mod 7 = 1), so 2027-01-01 is a Friday. 4 June 2027 is the 155th day of 2027; (155-1) mod 7 = 0, so it falls on the same weekday as 1 January, i.e. Friday — an ordinary business day, so no weekend/holiday shift under §193 BGB is triggered anyway. Due date: 4 June 2027.
